page.layout: One page of text in a single column, with no margin notes. Running head and page number at the top. Catchword "ante-" at the bottom right.

main_text.p: Amplificetur à minori per exemplum: Licet exemplo Augustini, Ambrosii, &c. in periculo tradere bona Ecclesiæ publica & aliena: multò magis privata & propria.
Conclusio: Nabothum ergo cedere petitioni Regis debuisse.
main_text.head: Pars affirmans.

head.i: Defensio Nabothi, quod iure negaverit vineam Achabo.

main_text.p: Propositio: Nabothum jure negasse vineam Achabo.
Ratio 1. quia tradedo peccasset in Legem Dei.

Probetur expositione Legis Levit. 25.23: & collatione petitionis Achabi cum ea: quod Deus vetuerit agros vendere, nisi cum conditione redimendi aut recipiendi eos anno lubilæo: Achabus contra voluerit vineam sibi vendi vel permutari mancipio: absque conditione.
Amplif. à maiori ex causa legis: Quia terra mea est: Colonis non licere fundos alienare nolentibus Dominis, multò minus Israelitis licuisse, prohibente Deo, cujus erant coloni.
1. non excipi jus Regium in lege.
Ratio: quia non fuerit jus, sed Tyrannis, cujus ostensio rejiciatur in confutationem primi argumenti.
Ratio:quia obedientia legis etiam vitæ fuerit

page.notes: The drop-cap P of "Propositio" is set as a large initial and joined to the word. The catchword "ante-" is at the lower right and is kept out of the text. The line "Amplificetur à minori" is italic only in its first word. The italic phrase "Quia terra mea est" is underlined in the scan; the underline is not reproduced. Long s is written as plain s throughout. No doubtful readings.
